projects.title: GCPLens | Premium GCP Usage & Location Insights Dashboard
projects.description: A high-end, futuristic dashboard designed to visualize Google Cloud resource usage, costs, and service health across global locations. Built with a focus on 'Vibrant' aesthetics and glassmorphism.

projects.title: Emo Narrator | AI-Powered Emotional Voice Generator
projects.description: A full-stack TypeScript application that brings text to life using emotional AI voices from ElevenLabs. Features real-time text-to-speech conversion with emotional context, request metrics tracking in AWS DynamoDB, and a modern Next.js interface.
